dct_description_sm: This article documents the public availability of three transcriptome sequences. These genomic resources were developed for the following species: Helianthus anomalus, Helianthus deserticola and Helianthus paradoxus.
dct_title_s: Data from: "Transcriptome resources for three hybrid sunflower species (Helianthus anomalus, H. deserticola, H paradoxus)" in Genomic Resources Notes accepted 1 February 2013–31 March 2013
